newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Moody's rates St George MBS issue Aaa.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates St George MBS issue Aaa.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it has assigned a Aaa rating to the proposed A$500 million bonds issued by Permanent Custodians Ltd in its capacity as trustee of the Crusade Trust No.1 of 1997.
The Crusade Trust is the first mortgage-backed securities (MBS) issue under the Crusade Trust established by St George Bank Ltd.

Moody's said the Aaa rating is based on a mortgage insurance policy provided to the programme by the Housing Loan Insurance Corporation, the availability of excess income to meet any principle charge off, liquidity support provided by a liquidity reserve account, the security provided by the charge granted to the security trust and the legal and structural integrity of the transaction.
Moody's said the rating was also based on the quality of the underlying residential mortgage loans.
Bankers Trust Australia Ltd is the lead manager and the sole dealer of the bonds issue. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
